sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Anti-Tarnish Charm Necklace for Daily wear
sourceNotes.rawContent:
- A modern and edgy statement piece, this gold necklace features a series of delicate triangle charms. The multi-point design creates a unique geometric pattern, adding a contemporary touch to your style. Made from durable anti-tarnish stainless steel with 18K gold plating, it's perfect for those who love bold, yet minimalist, accessories.
-
- Premium Quality | Anti-Tarnish
- Base Material: Stainless Steel
- Plating: 18K Gold-Plated
- Shape: Triangle
- Size: One-size & Adjustable
- Net Quantity: 1
- Designed to complement both casual and formal outfits effortlessly
- Care Tips:
-
- Wipe with a soft cloth after every use
- Avoid contact with harsh chemicals, sprays, and perfumes
- Store in a flat box to prevent scratches
- Do not soak in water
